divergence.text: Visa Inc.'s later filing says Central Bank of Brazil rules would obligate it to absorb certain settlement-related losses. Mastercard Incorporated's later filing says Brazil requires payment system operators, including Mastercard and Visa, to extend responsibility for the financial and settlement integrity of payments to merchants.

evidence.quote: the Central Bank of Brazil has adopted regulations applicable to payment networks like Visa that impose enhanced prudential requirements, including requirements that would obligate Visa to absorb certain settlement related losses for certain transactions involving sellers in Brazil when settlement failures occur and our risk mitigation measures do not fully protect against the resulting exposure.
Brazil recently enacted regulation requiring PSOs in Brazil (including Mastercard and Visa) to extend their responsibility for the financial and settlement integrity of payments to merchants.

themes.title: Settlement exposure from Brazil regulation
themes.what_changed: Visa Inc.'s later filing says Central Bank of Brazil rules would obligate it to absorb certain settlement-related losses, and that submitted rule provisions are expected to raise its settlement exposure. Mastercard Incorporated's later filing says Brazil requires payment system operators to extend their responsibility for the financial and settlement integrity of payments to merchants.
themes.audit_consideration: Does the audit plan cover the settlement-loss and settlement-integrity responsibilities the two filings describe for Brazil?

evidence.quote: the Central Bank of Brazil has adopted regulations applicable to payment networks like Visa that impose enhanced prudential requirements, including requirements that would obligate Visa to absorb certain settlement related losses for certain transactions involving sellers in Brazil when settlement failures occur and our risk mitigation measures do not fully protect against the resulting exposure.
we have submitted to the Central Bank of Brazil enhanced operating rule provisions, which, when approved, are expected to increase our settlement exposure and related collateral requirements.
Brazil recently enacted regulation requiring PSOs in Brazil (including Mastercard and Visa) to extend their responsibility for the financial and settlement integrity of payments to merchants.

themes.title: AI as a security and competitive risk
themes.what_changed: Mastercard Incorporated's later filing says the widespread use of AI is enhancing the frequency and effectiveness of threat actors. Visa Inc.'s later filing added that its use of AI depends in part on third-party large language models it does not control, and reworded existing language that AI intensifies competitive pressure.
themes.audit_consideration: Should the plan test how AI use, including reliance on third-party models, is governed and how AI-enabled attack scenarios feed into security and resilience monitoring at Visa Inc. and Mastercard Incorporated?

evidence.quote: The widespread use of AI, and its increasing capabilities, is enhancing the frequency and effectiveness of threat actors.

Our and our partners’ use of AI depends in part on third-party large language models that we do not control, whose models may generate inaccurate, biased, hallucinated or unexpected outputs that conflict with our business objectives or brand standards.

The rapid advancement of AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, intensifies competitive pressure in two key ways: first, competitors may use AI to enhance customer experiences, accelerate innovation, improve personalization, and create new payment and commerce experiences that drive adoption; and second, competitors may deploy AI internally to improve productivity, automate workflows, reduce costs and accelerate product development, potentially creating structural efficiency advantages.

themes.title: Expanded regulatory and licensing scope
themes.what_changed: Visa Inc.'s later filing says certain payment technologies and new capabilities in its growth strategy may bring increased licensing, supervisory and compliance obligations. Its cybersecurity discussion restates that these laws often impose control, governance, and incident-reporting obligations.
themes.audit_consideration: Does the plan assess whether the licensing, supervisory, and incident-reporting obligations described in the filing are tracked?

evidence.quote: In addition, certain payment technologies and services (e.g., tokenization, push payments and cross-border money movement) and new capabilities in furtherance of our multi-year growth strategy may bring increased licensing, supervisory and compliance obligations.
These laws and regulations often impose both specific cybersecurity control and governance requirements as well as incident reporting obligations.
